name: crazyflie_bl
notes: Crazyflie 2.1 Brushless (idsia-robotics/nanodrone-sysid-benchmark): mass 45 g, J = (2.3951, 2.3951, 3.2347)e-5 kg m^2 (RiftPhys order x roll, y yaw, z pitch), effective arm 35.35 mm; rotors 1 front-right, 2 back-right, 3 back-left, 4 front-left, 1 and 3 positive yaw torque (from the benchmark's PhysQuadModel mixer). Their identified kF 3.72e-8 N/(rad/s)^2 = 4.08e-4 N/krpm^2. Body frame: x forward, y up, z right. Yaw spin signs follow the data, not the benchmark code: regressing gyro-derived body torque on rotor speeds gives the opposite sign and ~8x the code's Kc (matching the paper's kM 7.73e-11); rotors 2 and 4 make positive yaw torque.
